entries.goal: Fix the Python implementation in solution.py. Repair clamp(value, lower, upper): return value bounded by the inclusive lower and upper limits. Raise ValueError when lower exceeds upper. Inputs are integers. Do not change the public function name. Make the edit and check the behavior. /no_think

files.solution.py:
def clamp(value, lower, upper):
    return max(lower, value)

Empty input returns a new empty list. Preserve elements and do not mutate the input. Make the edit and check the behavior. /no_think

files.solution.py:
def rotate_left(items, steps):

entries.goal: Fix the Python implementation in solution.py. Repair mask_digits(text, mask): text is a string. Require mask to be a string of exactly one character, otherwise raise ValueError. files.solution.py:
def mask_digits(text, mask):
    return ''.join(mask if c.isdigit() else c for c in text)

entries.goal: Fix the Python implementation in solution.py. Repair flatten_once(values): return a new list replacing each item that is a list with its immediate contents, exactly one level deep. Keep tuples and other non-list items as single items. Do not recursively flatten nested lists or mutate any input list. Make the edit and check the behavior. /no_think

files.solution.py:
def flatten_once(values):
    return [item for value in values for item in (value if isinstance(value,(list,tuple)) else [value])]
